name: Habitly
description: Playful habit-tracking app landing page with a pointer-tilting 3D phone mockup, cycling in-app screens and an animated streak flame.
features: CSS 3D phone mockup with three hand-built app screens and screen picker dots
Flickering streak flame with a count-up day counter
Three-tier pricing with a highlighted plan and App Store / Google Play buttons
Testimonials, FAQ accordion and a working contact form
signature: A 3D phone tilts with the mouse and cycles through in-app screens; a flickering streak flame counts up to 47 days
